## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, or explain why none were needed.
Distinguish scripted/stub tests, JVM tests, real inference and live MCP/device checks.
Mention remaining limitations relevant to this change.

## Contributor check

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/e2llm/trollm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/e2llm/trollm/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
- [ ] I reviewed the patch, including any agent-generated changes, and removed credentials and private diagnostics.
- [ ] Any specification, architecture or product design change was discussed with a maintainer.

Maintainers integrate accepted GitHub changes into the development source tree
before publishing a curated update. The resulting commit is linked here; this
pull request may be closed as integrated rather than merged directly on GitHub.
